summary.name: Mubert
summary.one_liner: Mubert is an AI music generator that creates royalty-free soundtracks and background music for videos, podcasts, and apps from text prompts or chosen mood, style, and duration.
use_cases: Generate background music for YouTube or TikTok videos
Score podcast episodes with music that ducks under voice
Create a soundtrack matching a short video clip
Check whether a song may trigger a YouTube Content ID claim
Add original AI music to a software app or game via API
summary.what_it_does: Mubert offers several tools: Mubert Render generates soundtracks matched to a chosen mood, style and duration; Chat to Music lets users describe a track and shape it conversationally; Mubert Cast offers transcript-based podcast editing, voice cleanup and auto-ducking music; Mubert Fuse generates music for an uploaded short clip and adds voice, sound effects and subtitles. A Copyright Checker estimates Content ID claim risk and suggests alternatives, and the Mubert API provides AI music for developers and brands. The page says the music is built from millions of samples from hundreds of artists and is royalty-free.
notable: Chat to Music for describing and shaping tracks in conversation
Mubert Cast edits podcasts by transcript with self-ducking music
Mubert Fuse generates music fitted to an uploaded video clip
Copyright Checker estimates YouTube Content ID claim risk
caveats: Pricing tiers and free-plan limits are not detailed on the page; freemium is taken from the directory listing
Commercial licensing terms are referenced in the FAQ but not spelled out in the page text
